$comment: Task #4180 — frozen baseline of files that DIRECTLY import each vendor SDK package (import/export-from/require/dynamic import of the package or any subpath). Task #4193 — vendors with 'detection': 'host' are fetch-based (no npm SDK): their files are the frozen set that references the vendor API host(s) in code (comments masked). Enforced by scripts/lint-vendor-confinement.ts: a net-new importer/host-caller outside this baseline fails the gate — route new vendor calls through the vendor's owning adapter instead. Existing importers are grandfathered (no forced refactor, per audits/architecture-governor-hardening-epic-approval.md). Task #4249 — vendors with 'envVars' also confine files that reference those vendor-URL env-var names in code (env-built URLs never show a literal host). Adding a file here is an L3 change requiring owner approval; removing stale entries (file deleted or no longer importing) is required shrink-only maintenance. 'adapter' is the designated owning adapter (informational; null = no canonical adapter designated yet — owner decision deferred, baseline frozen only). Task #5008 — every files/hosts/envVars entry must carry a matching per-entry record in the vendor's 'approvals' map (key file:<path> / host:<host> / env:<NAME> -> owner-approval reference); the lint fails on any unapproved entry and on any orphan approval, so baseline GROWTH (including regenerated output) is mechanically loud while shrinks stay free.
